description: Seven new flyable aircraft: three pairs of a historical aircraft and its rebuild with the game's 2080s technology (B-25H Mitchell and GA-25X, Hawker Nimrod Mk I and FD-32 Nimrod, B-17G Flying Fortress and MSB-17) and the A6M2 Zero Model 21. Own models, cockpits with working instruments and screens, flight and damage models, BDF and PALA liveries, stock weapons plus a few period guns. Needs Blueprinter; every player in a lobby and the host are expected to need the mod (multiplayer untested). Made with AI assistance (see the README).
